title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about Petit Verdot
objectives: Explain its role alone and in blends

steps.prompt: What does Petit Verdot add to Bordeaux blends?
steps.explanation: Small amounts add colour, structure and a floral, spicy lift.

steps.prompt: Petit Verdot ripens earlier than Cabernet Sauvignon.
steps.explanation: Not true. It ripens very late, often after Cabernet.

steps.prompt: Match each fact to Petit Verdot.
steps.explanation: Its story connects Bordeaux to new homes.

steps.prompt: Which regions make varietal Petit Verdot?
steps.explanation: Champagne grows Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier.

steps.prompt: Petit Verdot needs a long, ____ season to ripen.
steps.explanation: As a late ripener, warmth is essential.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Petit Verdot is dark, tannic, acidic and floral
It seasons Bordeaux blends in small amounts
Warm regions make it as a varietal
It suits rich, herby meat dishes
